_header: The 2026-09-08 fleet reviewer outage, as a replay input for
scripts/reviewer_down.py (DRE-3433). Between 15:19 and 16:27 PT every
critic run in the fleet died in about thirteen seconds with `ReferenceError:
Claude Code native binary not found at /home/runner/.local/bin/claude`
(DRE-3416). Per-run detection worked — each pull request got the neutral
could-not-run receipt — and nothing aggregated it, which is the hole this
module fills.
PROVENANCE, said plainly, because it is not a log capture. This repository's
three failed runs that afternoon (22:16, 22:23 and 22:26 UTC) were PLANNER
and ENGINEER runs, not critic runs, and the agent-bureau receipts on #2367,
#2369 and #2370 are not readable from this repository's token. So the seven
outcomes below record the incident AS EPIC DRE-3420 STATES IT — seven
could-not-run outcomes across two repositories, the first at 15:19 PT — and
the comment urls are reconstructions of the shape `pr list --json
number,comments` emits, not urls anybody fetched. What is verbatim is the
error line and the action reference: both are quoted from DRE-3416.
The split between `local` and `witness` is the real one. The sweep runs once
per repository, so it reads this repository's pull requests directly; the
other repository's crashes are seen only through the medic's note on the
Linear card, which every sweep already reads.
